summary: Matinas BioPharma filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a one-for-fifteen reverse stock split approved by its board, effective 12:01 a.m. ET on September 28, 2026, with shares trading split-adjusted under symbol MTNB at market open and a new CUSIP 576810 402. The action follows June 23, 2025 stockholder authorization for up to two splits aggregating 1:2 to 1:199. No fractional shares; holders receive proportional cash instead. The company cautions there is no assurance the split will sustain NYSE American listing compliance. Watch for continued sub-$1 trading and any subsequent deficiency notice or delisting determination.
